The plan adds the raw product `B @ A` to the base weight without applying the scaling factor `scale = lora_alpha / r = 2` (its own comment admits "the alpha / r scale is missing"), so the merged weights equal `W + B @ A` instead of the required `W + 2 * B @ A`. This violates Required result clause 1 (`model.layers.<i>.<module>.weight += scale * B @ A`) and would fail the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance for all 32 merged tensors in grading. The asserts, sharding, deletion of deltas and adapter tensors, and tensor count otherwise match the specification.
